title: Who Knows What - and What Does It Support? Perspective-Bounded Evidence Calibration for Multimodal Theory of Mind
title_zh: 谁知道什么——以及它支持什么？面向多模态心智理论视角有界的证据校准

paragraphs.en: 提出PIP-ToM证据可采纳性接口，结合GPT-4o校准多模态心智理论推断，三项基准准确率均超92%。 Theory of Mind (ToM), the ability to infer others' beliefs, goals, and intentions, is a cornerstone of social intelligence. Multimodal ToM requires inferring an agent's mental state from evidence that is available to that agent, rather than from the complete episode observed by the solver. Existing LLM-based and Bayesian model-based approaches reconstruct global event traces, yet they do not explicitly distinguish objective events from agent-admissible evidence during hypothesis evaluation. Consequently, agent-inaccessible events or semantically misaligned actions and utterances may influence the inferred belief, goal, or social intention, leading to perspective leakage and source or route confusion. We formulate this limitation as an evidence-admissibility problem: evidence should contribute to a mental-state hypothesis only when it is accessible to the relevant agent, preserves its information source, and is diagnostic of the queried mental-state variable. To operationalize this principle, we propose PIP-ToM, an evidence-admissibility interface that constructs agent-specific evidence stores, aligns them with structured mental-state claims, and calibrates model-based hypothesis scores while preserving the underlying Bayesian inference process. PIP-ToM with GPT-4o outperforms existing ToM methods across MuMA-ToM, MMToM-QA, and Hi-ToM, achieving average accuracies of 92.56%, 95.00%, and 95.00%, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出PIP-ToM证据可采纳性接口，结合基于GPT-4o的校准多模态心智理论推断，在三项基准上的准确率均超过92%。心智理论（Theory of Mind, ToM）即推断他人信念、目标与意图的能力，是社会智能的基石。 多模态心智理论要求从相关智能体可获得的信息证据出发，而非从求解者观察到的完整情节中，推断该智能体的心理状态。 现有的基于大语言模型的方法和基于贝叶斯模型的方法会重构全局事件轨迹，但在假设评估过程中并未显式区分客观事件与智能体可采纳的证据。 因此，智能体无法获取的事件，或语义上不匹配的动作与话语，可能影响所推断的信念、目标或社会意图，导致视角泄露以及信息来源或路径混淆。 我们将这一局限形式化为一个证据可采纳性问题：只有当证据对相关智能体可获取、保留其信息来源、并且对所查询的心理状态变量具有诊断性时，才应将其纳入心理状态假设。 为了将这一原则付诸实施，我们提出PIP-ToM，一个证据可采纳性接口，它构建智能体专属的证据库，将其与结构化的心理状态断言对齐，并在保留底层贝叶斯推断过程的同时校准基于模型的假设得分。 结合GPT-4o的PIP-ToM在MuMA-ToM、MMToM-QA和Hi-ToM三项基准上均优于现有心智理论方法，平均准确率分别达到92.56%、95.00%和95.00%。
